_comment: Rename to onchain_watchlist.json (drop .example) and edit before enabling ONCHAIN_ENABLED. Only entries whose chain is listed in ONCHAIN_CHAINS get scanned. Double-check every contract/mint address yourself before trusting it — a wrong address here means scanning (and potentially trading) the wrong token.
_format_note: This file should be a JSON *array* of entries, not an object. The two keys above are just documentation — delete them along with this note when you create the real file.
